name: Gia Lai Gong Festival
summary: The 2026 International Gong Festival and Wild Sunflower Week run 30 October through 8 November in Pleiku, Biển Hồ commune, and neighboring wards, with Gong Festival Night at 20:00 on 7 November at Dai Doan Ket Square and a street festival on 6 November. Later years: check on arrival.
